The percentage of expenditure on travel with respect to that on food is the maximum in which city?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Percentage = (Expenditure on Travel / Expenditure on Food) × 100

The percentage for each city

City A: (9 / 10) × 100 = 90%

City B: (7 / 12) × 100 ≈ 58.33%

City C: (11 / 18) × 100 ≈ 61.11%

City D: (5 / 13) × 100 ≈ 38.46%

City E: (20 / 21) × 100 ≈ 95.24%

The maximum percentage is in City E, which is approximately 95.24%.

**The percentage of expenditure on travel with respect to food is the maximum in City E.**
